diagnostic_steps.action: Parse log stream for quota exceeded events
findings: Resource quota exceeded for CPU: requested 500m, used 9500m, limited 10000m
Resource quota exceeded for memory: used 19Gi, limited 20Gi
Resource quota exceeded for services: used 9, limited 10
Resource quota exceeded for configmaps: used 49, limited 50
Dev-service deployment requires 500m CPU and 1Gi memory per replica
Quota limits too restrictive for development workload
Root cause: Resource quota limits too low for development needs
Contributing factor: Multiple dev workloads sharing same namespace
No resource cleanup of unused resources
Quota not adjusted for workload growth
diagnostic_steps.root_cause: Resource quota limits insufficient for development namespace workload

recommendations.rationale: Double CPU and memory quotas to accommodate development workloads
Increase object count quotas for services, configmaps, and PVCs

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: compute-resources
  namespace: development
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "20000m"
    requests.memory: 40Gi
    limits.cpu: "40000m"
    limits.memory: 80Gi
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Apply updated resource quota with request and limit separation
List old configmaps for cleanup review
List old services for cleanup review
Consider splitting development workloads into multiple namespaces

remediation_validation: Verify new resource quota limits applied
Monitor resource utilization to ensure adequate headroom
